# Plan snapshots (generated by Porter)

Porter copies Cursor working plan bodies here when `plans/index.yaml` lists a `cursorLeaf` that exists under `%USERPROFILE%\.cursor\plans` and the stem passes `porter/scope.json`.

Repo scars (`authority: repo`) stay under `../plans/` - not duplicated here.

Regenerate:

```powershell
pwsh -File ..\scripts\Invoke-MetraPorter.ps1
```
